assumptions.text: Boredom in everyday life is undesirable and worth overcoming.
Gamers value familiarity with established franchises like Call of Duty.
Free access to a high-quality game increases its appeal and likelihood of adoption.
Mobile games provide a valid and engaging alternative to real-world routines.
The target audience has smartphones capable of running Call of Duty Mobile.
People believe they can improve their mood or experience through digital entertainment.
Audiences trust promotional messages from official app stores.
